gold.purpose: The single accent: primary buttons, standalone gold labels, focus ring, selection, card lift ring (the content rails are no longer gold).

gold-bright.purpose: Link text at rest and the hover lift of gold surfaces.

gold-deep.purpose: Low end of the gold ramp: gradients and pressed/recessed gold.

error.purpose: The one non-gold signal: warm muted coral for form error feedback, readable on dark.

bench-night.purpose: Page background / the room; also text color on gold.

bench-panel.purpose: Banded sections, panels, footer — first tonal lift off the page.

bench-inset.purpose: Recessed wells: form inputs and inset surfaces.

ivory-ink.purpose: Headings and primary body copy — warm cream, never pure white.

mute-ink.purpose: Placeholders, captions, faintest meta text; lifted to clear 4.5:1 on near-black.

display.purpose: Page H1 / hero titles in Cormorant 600; tight, tall, balanced wrap.

lead.purpose: Intro sentence under a heading; Manrope 300, soft ink, max 56ch.

label.purpose: Uppercase gold standalone section labels (e.g. logo wall) and nav/button labels; wide tracking. Never a kicker above a heading.

shadows.name: ambient-drop
shadows.purpose: Large floated media and panels resting above the page.

shadows.name: gold-lift
shadows.purpose: Signature feature-card hover: a thin gold ring plus a deep diffuse drop, as if a spotlight found the card.

motion.name: ease-standard
motion.purpose: Default color/transform state transitions on links, buttons, inputs.

motion.name: ease-reveal
motion.purpose: Scroll-reveal: opacity + 18px rise, progressively enhanced behind .js.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Solid gold CTA; the one loud element, used sparingly.
components.css: .ds-btn { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:0.55em; min-height:52px; padding:0.85em 1.7em; font:600 0.82rem/1 'Manrope',system-ui,sans-serif; letter-spacing:0.14em; text-transform:uppercase; color:#0a0a0c; background:#d1a645; border:1px solid #d1a645; border-radius:2px; text-decoration:none; cursor:pointer; transition:background-color .2s,border-color .2s,transform .2s; } .ds-btn .ds-ic { transition:transform .25s; } .ds-btn:hover { background:#ecc677; border-color:#ecc677; transform:translateY(-2px); } .ds-btn:hover .ds-ic { transform:translateX(3px); } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #d1a645; outline-offset:3px; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Quiet secondary action; hairline border with a gold tint on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; min-height:52px; padding:0.85em 1.7em; font:600 0.82rem/1 'Manrope',system-ui,sans-serif; letter-spacing:0.14em; text-transform:uppercase; color:#f4f0e7; background:transparent; border:1px solid #34343f; border-radius:2px; text-decoration:none; cursor:pointer; transition:background-color .2s,color .2s,border-color .2s,transform .2s; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background:color-mix(in srgb,#d1a645 12%,transparent); color:#ecc677; border-color:#d1a645; transform:translateY(-2px); }

components.name: Standalone Gold Label
components.description: Uppercase gold label with an optional leading gold gradient tick. Used standalone to title a headingless section (e.g. the logo wall); never a kicker above a heading.
components.css: .ds-eyebrow { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:0.6em; font:600 0.78rem/1 'Manrope',system-ui,sans-serif; letter-spacing:0.28em; text-transform:uppercase; color:#d1a645; } .ds-eyebrow::before { content:''; width:2.2em; height:1px; background:linear-gradient(90deg,transparent,#d1a645); }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Inset field with micro-cap label; border goes gold and fill darkens on focus — no glow.
components.css: .ds-field { display:grid; gap:0.4rem; } .ds-field span { font:600 0.72rem/1 'Manrope',system-ui,sans-serif; letter-spacing:0.12em; text-transform:uppercase; color:#b4afa3; } .ds-field input { font:400 1rem/1.4 'Manrope',system-ui,sans-serif; color:#f4f0e7; background:#17171d; border:1px solid #34343f; border-radius:3px; padding:0.8em 0.9em; width:100%; transition:border-color .2s,background-color .2s; } .ds-field input::placeholder { color:#7c776e; } .ds-field input:focus { outline:none; border-color:#d1a645; background:color-mix(in srgb,#17171d 70%,#000); }

components.name: Nav Link
components.description: Uppercase grotesque nav link; soft ink at rest, brightens to ivory on hover.
components.css: .ds-nav { color:#b4afa3; font:500 0.82rem/1 'Manrope',system-ui,sans-serif; letter-spacing:0.1em; text-transform:uppercase; text-decoration:none; transition:color .2s; } .ds-nav:hover { color:#f4f0e7; }

components.name: Feature Card
components.description: Raised near-black card; flat at rest, gains the Gold Lift ring + diffuse drop on hover.
components.html:
Magic Show

Podmanivé sólové vystúpenie modernej mágie pre prestížne podujatia.
components.css: .ds-card { background:#1f1f27; border:1px solid #26262e; border-radius:3px; padding:2rem; color:#f4f0e7; transition:box-shadow .3s,transform .3s,border-color .3s; } .ds-card h3 { font:600 clamp(1.3rem,1.05rem + 1vw,1.8rem)/1.1 'Cormorant','Cormorant Garamond',Georgia,serif; margin:0 0 0.4em; } .ds-card p { color:#b4afa3; margin:0; } .ds-card:hover { border-color:transparent; box-shadow:0 0 0 1px color-mix(in srgb,#d1a645 30%,transparent),0 24px 60px -30px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.8); transform:translateY(-3px); }

narrative.overview: StrukShow is a black-tie room after dark. The lights are down, the conversation is hushed, and a single source of gold — a glint of gilt on an invitation, candlelight caught on a glass — is the only warmth in the frame. This is a world of refined luxury and discretion, not spectacle: the restraint is the point. A premium modern magician performing for private, exclusive and corporate galas is credible here precisely because the design never shouts. The surfaces are near-black and tonally layered, so depth comes from quiet contrast rather than shadow. The ink is a warm ivory, never pure white. Type carries the drama: Cormorant, a delicate high-contrast Garamond-didone, sets every heading like engraved gala stationery, while Manrope keeps everything functional calm and legible underneath. A single gold accent does all the persuading. The site is dark only, by design. Twin slightly-opaque white vertical rails frame the content column like a proscenium.
keyCharacteristics: Near-black tonal depth; no bright surfaces, no pure white, no light mode.
One gold accent, used rarely and always on purpose.
Theatrical didone headlines over a quiet grotesque body.
Framed composition: twin slightly-opaque white rails and darker margins as a proscenium.
Composed, luxurious, discreet — persuasion through restraint.

rules.name: The One Candle Rule
rules.body: Gold is the only accent and appears on a small fraction of any screen — a label, a button, a hairline. If a second accent hue or a flood of gold shows up, the room stops reading as candlelit and the illusion breaks.

rules.name: The No-White Rule
rules.body: The brightest ink is warm ivory (#f4f0e7) and the darkest surface is near-black (#0a0a0c). Never introduce pure #ffffff or a light surface; there is no light theme.

rules.name: The Marquee Rule
rules.body: All display type is Cormorant; the grotesque never sizes up to headline scale. Drama lives in the serif, order lives in the sans.

rules.name: The Bare Heading Rule
rules.body: Headings stand on their own; no kicker or eyebrow label sits above a heading. The gold label survives only to title a section that has no heading of its own.

rules.name: The Flat-Room Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest; lift (the Gold Lift ring) appears only as a response to hover or focus. Never pre-emboss resting UI with shadow.

dos: Do let each heading stand on its own in Cormorant, with no kicker or eyebrow label above it.
Do keep gold to a small fraction of any screen (The One Candle Rule).
Do build depth from the near-black tonal ramp and hairlines; reserve the two shadows for floated media and the Gold Lift hover.
Do keep headings in Cormorant and functional copy in Manrope.
Do keep corners near-square (2–3px) and draw structure with 1px hairlines.
Do honor dark-only: warm ivory is the brightest ink, near-black the darkest surface.
donts: Don't introduce a second accent hue or flood the page with gold.
Don't use pure #ffffff or any light surface, and don't add a light theme.
Don't size the grotesque up to headline scale or set a heading in the sans.
Don't pre-emboss resting UI with shadow or add pill shapes, heavy rounding, or decorative blobs.
Don't let any element collide with or redraw the twin content rails.
Don't place a kicker or eyebrow label above a heading; the heading carries its own weight.
Don't set display headings or hero accent words in italic; keep Cormorant display roman (italic stays for inline emphasis and pull-quotes).
